foundation: owner-v4 plus Fresnel fifth power and vertex base-color UV transform
hypothesis: Replace rescaling normalization with direct inverse sqrt only for bounded squared normal length in [0.25,4]. Keep original robust helper for cancellation/zero/tiny/overflow/nonfinite inputs.
numericalScope: Finite-precision rounding differs. Require exact canonical and paired rasters; no general bitwise equivalence claim. Fallback is byte-identical and double-sided sign handling is untouched.
qualityGate: Exact ordinary and paired images at three held views, same scene/settings/samples/draws.
performanceGate: >=10% lower queue than contemporary Three in both orders beyond drift; no E2E regression versus Three or immediate UV+Fresnel parent.
